name: Chicago Bulls
notes: The Chicago Bulls play in the NBA's Eastern Conference, Central Division, and call the United Center in Chicago home. The franchise's identity remains anchored in its 1990s dynasty under Michael Jordan and Scottie Pippen, which produced six championships between 1991 and 1998. Heading into the 2026-27 season the roster is built around a young core — Matas Buzelis, Josh Giddey, and 2025-26 draft picks Noa Essengue, Caleb Wilson, and Dailyn Swain — alongside veteran additions such as Nic Claxton and Norman Powell, under first-year head coach Tiago Splitter.

roster.facts: Signed a 4-year, $100M extension in 2026 after a career 2024-25 season with 7 triple-doubles, cementing him as Chicago's franchise cornerstone.
roster.name: Josh Giddey

roster.facts: Joined on a 2-year, $45M deal in July 2026, fresh off his first career All-Star nod averaging 21.7 ppg with Miami.
roster.name: Norman Powell

roster.facts: Broke out in 2025-26, averaging 16.3 ppg as the starting small forward and emerging as the Bulls' young building block.
roster.name: Matas Buzelis

roster.facts: Drafted 4th overall in June 2026 out of North Carolina, immediately slotted in as Chicago's starting power forward as a rookie.
roster.name: Caleb Wilson

roster.facts: Acquired from Brooklyn in a three-team trade the night before the 2026 draft to be the Bulls' new defensive-anchor starting center.
roster.name: Nic Claxton

roster.facts: Re-signed and set as the starting point guard alongside Giddey for 2026-27 after posting 14.1 points and 5.4 assists per game last season.
roster.name: Tre Jones

roster.facts: Acquired from Cleveland for Lonzo Ball in July 2025; the former lottery pick projects as a starting wing/defender entering 2026-27.
roster.name: Isaac Okoro

roster.facts: Enters year three of his $90M deal amid persistent trade speculation after a career-low 37.2% shooting season and multiple 2025-26 injuries.
roster.name: Patrick Williams

roster.facts: Filled in as a starter for stretches of 2025-26, averaging 12.1 points and 7.1 rebounds in those games while auditioning for a frontcourt role.
roster.name: Jalen Smith

roster.facts: The No. 12 pick in the 2025 draft, the French rookie's debut season was cut short by season-ending shoulder surgery in December 2025.
roster.name: Noa Essengue

roster.facts: Acquired from Minnesota at the February 2026 deadline, the former No. 8 pick got a fresh start with expanded minutes in Chicago.
roster.name: Rob Dillingham

roster.facts: Came over in the February 2026 Dillingham trade and impressed immediately, averaging 11.7 points and 5.8 rebounds on 56% shooting for the Bulls.
roster.name: Leonard Miller

roster.facts: Season ended early after right toe surgery in 2025-26, though he'd been efficient (9.7 ppg, 57.8% FG) before the injury as a frontcourt reserve.
roster.name: Zach Collins

roster.facts: Drafted 15th overall out of Texas in June 2026, the rookie wing brings size and playmaking upside as a developmental bench piece.
roster.name: Dailyn Swain

roster.facts: Split 2025-26 between Chicago and New York before returning to the Bulls, now in a limited bench frontcourt role averaging 5.6 points per game.
roster.name: Guerschon Yabusele
